Meta.title: Nexus Life — design your days with clarity
Meta.description: Focus, tasks, habits and spending in one daily system.

Hero.title: Design your days with clarity.
Hero.subtitle: Focus, tasks, habits and spending in one place. Scroll down to fly through the app.

focus.title: A focus block, no noise
focus.copy: Pick what matters, start the timer, and let the sound tell you when you're done.

tasks.title: Tasks with real priority
tasks.copy: High, medium or low, with a due date. Your daily agenda builds itself.

habits.title: Habits that stick
habits.copy: Daily, weekly or monthly. See your streak and what's left for today.

finance.title: Your spending, by category
finance.copy: Log it in seconds and see where your money goes each week.

habits.title: Habits
habits.streak: Current streak: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

Footer.title: A clear day starts with a single system.
Footer.note: Personal learning project. Built with Next.js, GSAP and Lenis.

Features.title: Everything you need for your day
Features.lead: Five modules that work together. Here's what each one does.

focus.title: Focus
focus.lead: Work sessions with a single goal.
focus.p1: Pick the task that matters and start a timer.
focus.p2: Pause and resume without losing your thread.
focus.p3: A sound tells you when you pause and when the session is done.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: What's pending, ordered by what matters.
tasks.p1: High, medium or low priority on every task.
tasks.p2: Status and due date so nothing slips by.
tasks.p3: Your daily agenda is built from your tasks.

habits.title: Habits
habits.p2: Progress per habit and your current streak.
habits.p3: Charts to see how you're doing over time.

finance.title: Finance
finance.p3: Charts to spot what weighs the most.

insights.title: Insights
insights.p1: Trends on how your week is going.
insights.p3: A summary on the home screen to start the day with context.

About.title: About us
About.lead: Nexus Life is an independent project born from a simple idea: organizing your day shouldn't take five different apps.
About.body: We're building it step by step and learning along the way: a React Native mobile app and this Next.js website, with the care of a real product.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Every screen shows what you need to decide what's next.

calm.title: Calm
calm.text: A serene design that helps you focus instead of getting distracted.

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.text: Tools to sustain habits, not just to start them.
